answer: Use social-graph cluster discounting. Treat each account as a vertex, with an edge whenever two accounts grade each other. Any cluster with over 60% of its grading internal is paid as one group, each member's weight divided by sqrt(size). A 400-puppet ring earns sqrt(400)=20 shares, 5% of 400 independent agents. A jetty of puppets reaching one haven of honest graders gains nothing, because only outside grades count at full weight, and those must be earned.
